citations: I was able to have the opportunity to work as the marketing and social media intern for Garrett Brands.
I worked 40 hours a week and worked from June to the beginning of September.

Daily, I would manage Garrett’s social media accounts, manage community engagement through Sprout Social, and assist with various projects and campaigns. I would help create paid ads for their social media platforms, work on influencer relations and partnerships, and assist in brainstorming sessions for our holiday campaigns. Aside from those tasks, I also attended many field marketing events throughout the city of Chicago.

detailed_results.feedback: The student articulates several distinct and valuable learnings, providing specific examples for each. The detailed explanation of the influencer marketing process, the importance of field marketing, the steps in campaign building, and the impact of social media virality demonstrates a strong grasp of new knowledge gained.
citations: One new thing that I learned this summer was the importance of influencer marketing. It was extremely valuable to see the whole process for reaching out to influencers, negotiation, brief drafting, execution, and invoicing.
Additionally, one thing I also learned in terms of our RTE line was the importance of field marketing events to increase brand awareness.
I also learned the steps that go into building a campaign from the beginning stages of just brainstorming to the execution.
One thing I also learned was the importance of social media for our products today. If a new recipe or something else went “viral” on TikTok or Instagram, it would dramatically increase our sales.

detailed_results.feedback: Two clear and well-explained surprises are presented. The rapid growth of the RTE Popcorn line and the strategic, phased approach to retail expansion are insightful observations. The student effectively contrasts their experience from the first summer to the second, highlighting the significant changes and the underlying strategy.
citations: One thing that really surprised me was how fast our RTE Popcorn grew.

My first summer, we were just beginning to get into mostly local grocery stores. This summer, we had grown way beyond. We are now in all Walmarts, Sam's Club and Costco, and retailers throughout the Midwest.

Another thing that surprised me was the strategy behind Garrett Popcorn's expansion into the retail space. Instead of going all at once on a national level, they started small to slowly gain more local recognition and strength, and then became stronger on a slower level.

I can also discuss how I learned and developed skills in social media strategy when creating organic and paid content.

A final thing I can discuss in job interviews is how I saw the company first-hand grow into the retail sector through various strategies, such as field marketing events, increasing our social media presence, and more.

detailed_results.feedback: The student thoroughly addresses all components of the EMPAC model (Entertainment, Matching, Price, Assortment, Convenience) with specific, relevant examples from their internship. The observations are insightful, demonstrating a clear understanding of how Garrett Brands applies these marketing principles in practice, from social media engagement to strategic collaborations and retail expansion.
citations: In terms of entertainment, I found this to be incredibly important. Garrett prides itself on being a fun brand that engages many.

I think one thing that was incredibly important in terms of entertainment was our use of social media and influencer marketing. This allowed us to engage the customer with the brand in a different way.
For Matching, I think it was incredibly important that we found influencers and other brands to collaborate with that align with our brand's values and image.
One way we did this was by teaming up with many Chicago-based influencers to highlight our brand identity of being a Chicago-born and bred brand.

In terms of price, our LTO recipes (limited-time offer) and our promotions allowed us to create more of an incentive for the customers to purchase. During the summer, we had a “hot summer deals” campaign that had promotions throughout the summer to increase sales.

This also plays into our Assortment. We are constantly rotating different collaborations and seasonal recipes. In terms of our RTE- during the summer, we featured more summery flavors that play into summer activities such as Smoked BBQ.

I think convenience was a big factor that I observed growth in during my time at Garrett. Through Garrett's expansion into grocery stores such as Walmart, Costco, and Sam's Club. Garrett Popcorn became extremely more accessible to people in any state.
